meta.name: image-to-code
meta.description: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping old ones, avoid lazy under-generation, avoid cards-inside-cards-inside-cards UI, and keep the hero clean, spacious, readable, and visible on a small laptop.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将设计图转化为精确的网站代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从设计图生成高质量网页代码
copy.tagline_en: Convert design images into precise website code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate high-quality website code from design images

howto.what: 装上后,做视觉要求高的网页任务时,它会先生成各区块的设计图并逐张深入分析,再据此写前端代码,让成品尽量贴近图片。
howto.when: 当你要求做 hero 首屏、落地页、改版等以视觉为主的页面,且环境支持生成图片时接管;偏技术的修 bug 或你已给出精确设计规范时不必。

say.text: 帮我做一个创业公司落地页,先出设计图再写代码
say.note: 它会按区块分别生成参考图再实现

say.text: 把这个 hero 首屏重新生成一张更清晰的分析用设计图
say.note: 它会保持同一设计语言重新出图

say.text: 把这个作品集网站改版得更有设计感
say.note: 它会先推断区块数并逐张生成设计图

howto.what_en: Once installed, for visually important web tasks it first generates section design images, analyzes each one in depth, then writes the frontend code to match them as closely as possible.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a hero section, landing page, or redesign that is mostly visual and image generation is available. It steps back for technical fixes or an already precise design system.

say_en.text: Build a startup landing page: design images first, then code
say_en.note: It generates reference images per section, then implements

say_en.text: Regenerate a clearer standalone design image of this hero section
say_en.note: It keeps the same design language

say_en.text: Redesign this portfolio site to feel more art-directed
say_en.note: It infers the section count and generates images per section
